job.job_title: Full Stack AI Systems Engineer Intern
job.job_description:
\- Codes regularly (GitHub shows commits, not course projects)

\- Curious about AI \\u2014 not intimidated, actively interested

\- Can explain your own projects (shows real learning, not copy\-paste)

\- Handles ambiguity ("how should I approach this?" not "tell me what to do")

\- Ships code fast (MVP > perfect)

\- Sees this as a growth opportunity (not a resume line)

NOT looking for:

\- "I did a boot\-camp course" mentality (we need builders, not learners)

\- People intimidated by AI tools (we use Copilot\/Claude daily)

\- 9\-5 mindset (intensity required)

\- "Whats the exact job description?" people (role emerges from execution)

WHAT YOULL DO

\- Weeks 1\-2: Onboarded by our tech architect. Learn our Agentic architecture. Read 500+ pages of docs (seriously, this is your superpower).

\-Weeks 3\-4: Build your first agent (small, real, shipped to customers).

\- Month 1: 50+ commits. 3\-4 shipped agents. Your code is being used.

\- Months 2\-3: 100+ commits. Mentoring starts (someone junior asks you questions). Exceptional ones get full\-time offers.

\- Months 3\-6: 150+ commits. Core systems builder. Talking about "what should our architecture be?"

Benefits
WHAT YOULL LEARN

\- Agentic AI systems: How to build autonomous agents that actually work

\- Full\-stack: Frontend (Next.js) + Backend (Node.js\/TypeScript) + AI integration

\- System design: Understanding distributed systems, databases, governance

\- Documentation as code: How to think in writing (5000+ pages is your blueprint)

\- AI tools as superpower: Claude, Copilot, Perplexity\\u2014not replacements, but multipliers

\- How real startups operate: Direct founder access, seeing deals happen, market fit iteration
